meta.name: n3xu5 Web Infrastructure
meta.description: Complete infrastructure graph for n0v4-n3xu5.art + n3xu5.art — workers, databases, buckets, routes, domains, external services.

nodes.label: homepage
nodes.detail: Static assets worker. Serves index.html (no-JS cyberdelic homepage), WKD keys, _headers. No bindings.

nodes.label: n3xu5-auth
nodes.detail: Auth + API + server-rendered pages. 1640 lines. PGP 2FA, D1 sessions, calendar API, SSO IdP, crew board, webmail read.

nodes.label: n3xu5-email-gate
nodes.detail: Email ingest worker. Parses MIME, encrypts per-recipient PGP, stores to R2 + D1. Triggered by Cloudflare Email Routing.

nodes.label: D1: n3xu5-auth
nodes.detail: Shared D1 database. 18 tables: users, sessions, pgp_challenges, events, calendar_shares, board_posts, mail_objects, sso_clients, sso_tickets, etc.

nodes.label: R2: n3xu5-mail
nodes.detail: Encrypted mail storage. PGP-encrypted raw MIME messages. Written by email-gate, read by auth worker for .gpg downloads.

nodes.label: RL_AUTH
nodes.detail: Rate limit: 5 attempts/min/IP for auth login/verify.

nodes.label: RL_MSG
nodes.detail: Rate limit: 3 messages/min/IP for guest contact form.

nodes.label: DAILY_SALT
nodes.detail: Salt for IP hashing in messages.ip_hash.

nodes.label: RESEND_API_KEY
nodes.detail: Resend relay API key for outbound email sending.

nodes.label: n0v4-n3xu5.art
nodes.detail: Primary persona domain. Serves homepage, auth, webmail, admin, board, SSO, calendar. DNS on Cloudflare, registered at Porkbun.

nodes.label: n3xu5.art
nodes.detail: Federation apex. Same auth worker, same D1. Shared IdP + crew hub. Dual-routed.

nodes.label: forsythzines.art
nodes.detail: Forsyth Zines business domain. Separate CF account. Static site + research gate Worker. SSO relying party.

nodes.label: SSO IdP
nodes.detail: SSO Identity Provider. Issues tickets for relying parties (forsythzines). Endpoints: /sso/authorize, /sso/verify.

nodes.label: Email Routing
nodes.detail: Cloudflare Email Routing. MX for both .art zones. Catch-all → email-gate worker.

nodes.label: Calendar API
nodes.detail: REST API at /api/cal/*. 7 endpoints: events, event CRUD, actions, share/unshare, projects. Hierarchy: task/event/quest/ritual.

nodes.label: Resend
nodes.detail: Outbound email relay. Free tier ~100/day. Domain n0v4-n3xu5.art needs SPF/DKIM/DMARC.

nodes.label: Porkbun
nodes.detail: Domain registrar. n0v4-n3xu5.art and n3xu5.art. WHOIS privacy enabled.

nodes.label: C2-Panel
nodes.detail: Local Go app. Thin client over workers. Dashboard: admin, webmail, board, messages.
